Directions for Questions 96 to 100:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:
"Discipline is the cornerstone of individual character and national vitality. Without disciplined exertion, the most
brilliant talents wither away in idle indulgence. In nature, every celestial body and seasonal cycle is governed by
precise, immutable order. Similarly, an individual who masters their desires, manages their hours prudently, and
adheres to ethical principles attains self-reliance and peace of mind. A nation comprised of self-disciplined citizens
possesses an enduring shield against internal decay and external adversaries alike."
questions.questionText: According to the passage, what happens to talent without discipline?
options: It withers away in idle indulgence
